name: Ramp
text: We should add a 3px solid #005FCC focus ring with no glow to ensure keyboard navigation is accessible. This decision meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements, making it usable for everyone, including those with visual impairments. By choosing this option, we're accepting the trade-off of a slightly more prominent focus ring, which may not be as aesthetically pleasing as a more subtle design, but it prioritizes accessibility and inclusivity. This choice also aligns with our goal of making EXCAVA usable by everyone, as it provides a clear visual indicator for keyboard users.

name: Reader
text: The 3px solid ring risks crowding small touch targets on mobile—buttons under 48px will fail WCAG 2.1 touch size. A 2px ring with 1px outer glow keeps contrast while freeing space. Test with Playwright MCP on iOS Safari at 400% zoom to settle it.
